time_class.instructions: What kind of physician time does this description refer to? Choose unclear if the text does not say.

criteria.provider_admin: Administration or medical direction of a hospital department, unit, service or program
criteria.provider_supervision: Supervising or training nurses, technicians or other hospital staff
criteria.provider_committee_qa: Committee work, utilization review, quality assurance or quality improvement
criteria.provider_availability: On-call or emergency availability paid by the hospital, not tied to a specific patient
criteria.gme_teaching: Teaching or supervising residents or fellows in an accredited training program, including program director roles
criteria.professional: Medical or surgical care of individual patients
criteria.research: Research, whether sponsored or internally funded
criteria.other_nonreimbursable: Work for another organization, fundraising, or other activity the hospital does not claim
criteria.leave: Leave, sabbatical or other paid time away

is_provider_component.instructions: Is this time spent on duties that benefit patients generally (administration, medical direction, supervision of staff, committee work, availability) rather than care of individual patients, resident teaching, or research?

rce_specialty.instructions: Which specialty group does the specialty text belong to?

criteria.other_total: Any other specialty, or the text does not say
